schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh across four bands — Shishu (≤₹50k), Kishor (₹50k–5L), Tarun (₹5–10L) and Tarun Plus (₹10–20L) — for micro & small enterprises.

citation.source: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Official Portal

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (KVIB)
schemes.benefit: Margin-money subsidy of 15–35% of project cost on bank credit of 90–95%. Maximum project cost ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 lakh (service / trading). New units only.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.benefit: Bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore (₹2 crore after the 2025 relaunch) for at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch, for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
docs: Project report for the greenfield unit
Caste certificate (SC/ST) or gender proof for women borrowers
No prior benefit / first-time entrepreneur declaration

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.benefit: Government credit guarantee enabling collateral-free loans up to ₹10 crore for micro & small enterprises, with guarantee cover of 75–90% and fees as low as 0.37% p.a. Special benefits for women entrepreneurs.
docs: Project report and viable business plan
